title: .JPG File Extension - How to Open, Convert & Repair JPG Files
description: Complete reference for .JPG (JPEG) image files. Discover how to open JPGs on Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS, convert JPG to PDF/PNG/WEBP, and repair corrupted headers.

tips: Verify extension isn't double-extended like photo.jpg.exe
Inspect magic byte header (FF D8 FF E0) if image refuses to load
Scan files downloaded from unverified websites

title: .PNG File Extension - Portable Network Graphics Specs & Software
description: Learn about .PNG image files featuring alpha transparency. Discover compatible PNG viewers, online PNG to JPG/WEBP converters, and file header validation.

tips: Ensure PNG header magic bytes (89 50 4E 47 0D 0A 1A 0A) are intact
Check transparency alpha channel encoding if background renders black

title: .PDF File Extension - Universal Document Format Guide
description: Complete specification for Portable Document Format (.PDF). Learn how to open, merge, compress, convert, and repair PDF documents across all operating systems.

tips: Disable automatic JavaScript execution in PDF reader settings
Do not click untrusted external URLs embedded inside PDF files
Verify PDF digital signatures before accepting official contracts

title: .HEIC File Extension - High Efficiency Image Format Reference
description: Master Apple's High Efficiency Image Container (.HEIC). Discover how to open HEIC files on Windows PC, convert HEIC to JPG online, and adjust camera settings.

tips: Install Windows HEVC Video Extensions codec if image preview is black
Convert HEIC to JPG for sharing with legacy non-Apple devices

title: .DOCX File Extension - Microsoft Word Document Specification
description: Complete guide to .DOCX XML documents. Discover how to open DOCX files without Microsoft Office, convert DOCX to PDF, and repair damaged Word files.

tips: Beware of macro-enabled documents (DOCM) disguised as DOCX
Always open untrusted word documents in Protected View mode

title: .ZIP File Extension - Compressed Archive Format Reference
description: Learn how to extract, compress, and password-protect .ZIP archives. Explore top unzippers including 7-Zip, WinRAR, and native OS utilities.

tips: Scan archive contents with an antivirus before extracting executable files
Watch out for zip-bomb compression exploits in untrusted files

title: .MP4 File Extension - MPEG-4 Video Container Specifications
description: Comprehensive reference for .MP4 video files. Learn about H.264/HEVC codecs, compatible media players like VLC, and video conversion tools.

tips: Ensure media player codecs are updated to prevent buffer overflow vulnerabilities
Check that .mp4 file doesn't conceal double extensions like video.mp4.exe

title: .SVG File Extension - Scalable Vector Graphics Format
description: Complete guide to XML-based .SVG vector graphics. Learn how to open, edit, optimize, and safely render SVG vector graphics for web development.

tips: Sanitize SVG files to remove embedded <script> tags before rendering in web applications
Use SVGO optimization tools to strip unnecessary script payloads
